headline: IT services growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others saw modest or declining performance.
summary: Coforge led the quarter with over 50% revenue growth, driven by AI‑focused deals. HCLTech and TCS delivered solid top‑line growth and expanding margins, supported by AI revenue contributions. Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance as revenue growth slowed to 1‑2%. Wipro posted revenue growth but profit fell, reflecting mixed execution.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Companies that disclosed AI revenue or AI‑led deals (Coforge, HCLTech, TCS) posted higher growth and margin expansion.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: Infosys and Wipro saw margins under pressure as revenue growth slowed and cost structures tightened.
